subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's custom yielding glob walker and bootstrap-hook scheduling as the bounded fix for the linked bootstrap-context stall?
rationale: The patch is correct and well-proven for the reported hot path, but it replaces dependency behavior and changes scheduling on compatibility-sensitive prompt and session surfaces, which automation should not accept unilaterally.

options.title: Land after exact-head verification
options.body: Accept the focused design, refresh checks against current main, review the merge result, and land the PR.

options.title: Request one live gateway run
options.body: Require a current-head embedded run with concurrent gateway or channel liveness output before accepting the compatibility risk.

options.title: Pause for broader architecture
options.body: Keep or close the PR if owners prefer worker isolation or another filesystem design instead of maintaining a custom glob walker.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head verification
recommendation.body: Accept the focused design, refresh checks against current main, review the merge result, and land the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history spans the bootstrap hook, internal-hook, and guarded workspace-read boundaries that define this tradeoff.
